name: SignGraph holds relations, sites, Ports and the organization of cells, and nothing that belongs to a consumer
asks: SignGraph holds almost nothing of SignGraph and much that belongs to downstream consumers, such as the feather graph codecs. Move that material to its consumers and make SignGraph a coherent library.

met-when.says: No export reads or writes a named format, protocol or standard (FEATHER-G, DOT, CSV, JSON Schema, SEN, OTLP and the like). Each such reader or writer is in the section of its format and imports SignGraph.
A module whose definitions never mention a cell, a relation between cells, a site or a Port is not in SignGraph: mathematics is imported from Metrologic.
No export exists for one named downstream application. What only one consumer uses is in that consumer.

sources.words: SignGraph holds almost nothing of SignGraph and much that belongs to downstream consumers, such as the feather graph codecs. Move that material to its consumers and make SignGraph a coherent library.

x-provenance.acceptance: Each command names one test file in this repository. A test file that does not exist yet fails its command, so the condition reads unmet until the test is written and passes.
